affected_groups: Douglas County residents using Faith Food Pantry
households relying on emergency food assistance
items.editorial_note: Approved for the July 31 Food Line draft. The closure and recent service volume are directly documented. Preserve uncertainty about the capacity and equivalent accessibility of the Duluth referral site.
items.exact_supporting_passage: The pantry opened in 1994 and served residents across Douglas County. It recently provided food to an average of 960 people and distributed approximately 34,000 pounds of food each month. Leaders said the church building’s aging condition and the cost of necessary repairs made it impossible to continue operating the pantry safely and sustainably.
items.proposed_public_headline: Superior food pantry closes after more than 30 years
items.proposed_public_summary: Faith Food Pantry in Superior closed after its final distribution on July 28. The pantry had recently served about 960 people and distributed approximately 34,000 pounds of food per month across Douglas County. People seeking assistance were directed to Second Harvest Northland in Duluth, but available reporting does not establish whether that alternative has sufficient capacity or equivalent accessibility.
items.title: Superior food pantry closing after more than 30 years
items.uncertainty_note: Available reporting does not establish whether Second Harvest Northland has sufficient capacity or equivalent accessibility for displaced Faith Food Pantry users.
items.why_it_matters: The closure removes a substantial local food-distribution site and may shift demand and transportation burdens to other providers.
